Claim: dev seat session `session_01W6HFzyH98W1YaQXhJUJt6o`, dispatched by the `domain:engine` PM seat, branch `claude/issue-12393-value-roundtrip-caseset`.

Blocker confirmed cleared before starting: #12380's route-A fix is on `origin/main` as `4045b954d3`. Assignee untouched (PM already claimed).

Scope as briefed: a `VALUE_ROUNDTRIP` case-set in `packages/spec/src/data/*-conformance.ts` plus its census wiring. Sizing will be **re-measured** here, not inherited; the two named tripwires (#5499 driver freeze, and #12136's "a gate that ships red is worse than one that ships honest") are read and will be reported against explicitly.

## Dispatch stalled with **zero** work produced — un-claimed, back to `pm:queue`

Same stall as #12068 / #11671, but this one left nothing to recover. Measured at 09:00Z on the seat's own worktree: `0` commits ahead of `origin/main`, clean working tree, and `origin/claude/issue-12393-value-roundtrip-caseset` still at the base `af56546adb`. Nothing was written.

So the honest state is **unclaimed**, not "in progress": `pm:dispatched` + an assignee on a card with no work behind it is exactly the false signal that makes another agent skip it. Labels and assignee reverted to match reality.

The card itself is untouched and still fully specified — it is #12380 route D and stands as filed. It is **not** being re-dispatched in this batch only because the slot went to #12394 (autonumber high-water destruction, `target:18`), which is a live data-corruption card and outranks a coverage extension. Next free slot.

Third recurrence of the #12188 stall shape in this shift; the zero-output case is the sharpest instance of it so far, since nothing at all distinguishes a dead seat from a working one at the card level.

## Re-claimed and dispatched — the slot freed up

- **Session**: `session_01W6HFzyH98W1YaQXhJUJt6o` (seat post #6367)
- **Branch**: `claude/issue-12393-value-roundtrip-caseset` — the same branch, still at its base `af56546adb` because the stalled seat wrote nothing to it
- Comments re-read in the same action as the claim: two, both from this seat (the dead dispatch's own claim comment, and my stall record). No other session has a claim here.

**Blocker re-verified by content on `origin/main`, not inherited from the dead seat's claim comment**: `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-12380-json-roundtrip.test.ts` is present, and `injective` resolves 6× in `sql-driver.ts` with `getNextSequenceValue` firing 8× in the same scan as the positive control. #12380's route-A fix has landed, so this card can no longer ship a gate that is red on SQLite by construction.

The card's own instructions are carried into the dispatch intact rather than paraphrased: sizing is **re-measured at claim time**, never guessed; #5499's investment freeze on `driver-memory` / `driver-mongodb` is read *first* and scoped against, with the explicit warning that the freeze must not be allowed to make the case-set vacuous; and #12136's ruling — a gate that ships red is worse than one that ships honest — governs whatever this surfaces, with the reminder that a `DIALECT` ledger row deliberately does not clear `MATRIXED`, so a new escape hatch must not re-open what was just narrowed.

Anything this newly reds is a real finding to route, not a number to tune away.
